name: spaces_rename
description: Set the persistent name of a Space. One via `spaceId` + `name`, a batch via `items`. @see guides_get('spaces')

items.description: Batch form, exclusive with `spaceId`. Max 50. Unrenameable items come back in `skipped` instead of aborting the batch.

name.description: Goes with `spaceId`. Max 255 chars; trimmed; blank rejected.
